description: Ascending key inserts into a unique Text index of long keys: IxT has 60 rows (ID 1..60, W 'k' + a four-digit number + 40 'p' characters) and unique index UX_IxT_W. Four statements add 20 rows each with higher keys. Asks at which statement the index leaf is split and where the new keys land. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it, with the DBEngine still alive.
retentionNote: Designed r-fmt-2b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
